prior_importants.description: Test adequacy: fakeGh ignores the `--jq` filter and the GraphQL `query=` text, so dropping the `or .event == "renamed"` clause added by this fix, the `.label.name == "ready"` filter, the TSV field order, or the `lastEditedAt` field leaves every test green while real gh lets an edited or wrongly labelled issue through.

process_issues.description: Round 4, so only importants were in budget. conventions, docs, simplicity, context and maintainability were skipped as the round budget requires. spec was skipped because there is no closing keyword or linked issue, and workflow-safety because no workflow changed. The diff is 722 lines (294 source and 428 test), so correctness and security each ran 2 instances: correctness split into approval/timestamp logic and orchestration/errors/tests, security into the argv/process boundary and the approval trust model. The head (7796e51) is the same one the prior record reviewed. That record had no important findings. Its unresolved prior_importants[0] is still unresolved: fakeGh (test lines 46-80) still ignores the GraphQL query text, so mutants of the query survive. Freshness re-check: HEAD matches the PR's headRefOid. Every reviewer returned no findings, so no consolidator or validator was spawned.
